# Bundled local OCR

Tesseract.js 7.0.0 and tesseract.js-core 7.0.0: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js and https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core. Apache License 2.0; see bundled LICENSE files and minified dependency notices.

English LSTM data: @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int/eng.traineddata.gz, https://github.com/naptha/tessdata. The data package declares Apache-2.0; the full license is included as tesseract.js-core-LICENSE.

All executable code and recognition data are included in this extension. No CDN scripts or remote recognition service is used.
